answer: Each identity claims one dune plot, locks an 80-credit bond, and sets a marble marker etched with its key serial. A falcon patrol photographs each marker each epoch and posts photo and coordinates. An auditor checks each photo against the registry; a missing marker, one moved over two metres, or one under two keys burns the bond. First marker 34 credits, kth 34+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6028 and 1000 fakes cost 3,031,000 credits plus 80,000 bonds. A rented-marker ring fails: one serial cannot serve two keys. An honest identity pays 34 once and recovers its bond after audit.
